paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Accuracy comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, Ex1 and Ex2, during the training process. The x-axis represents the step number, ranging from 0 to 60000 with a tick interval of 10000, and is labeled “Step”. The y-axis represents the accuracy (Next Token Prediction), measured on a scale from 0.10 to 0.40 with a tick interval of 0.05, and is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)”. The Ex1 model is represented by a solid blue line that starts at approximately 0.40 and declines to approximately 0.30 between steps 0 and 10000. After this point the blue line increases to approximately 0.40, maintaining a steady value from 10000 to 60000. The Ex2 model is depicted by a green line that begins at approximately 0.30 and rises to approximately 0.38 between steps 0 and 10000. Afterwards, the green line decreases to approximately 0.35 between steps 10000 and 60000.
